function: UE-side learned decision whether to feed back full CSI (feedback reduction), trained for sum-rate under an average feedback constraint; BS scheduling and ZF are fixed (p. 3, p. 4).
system: Single-cell MU-MIMO downlink, BS with ULA 1x32 or UPA 4x8, single-antenna UEs (20-100), 7 GHz narrowband, UMi cell radius 100 m; no RIS (p. 3, p. 8).
method: UE-side DNN (1D convolution, FC, tanh, sigmoid threshold), unsupervised: primal-dual Lagrangian with straight-through estimator, or policy gradient with Bernoulli policy; one DNN per setup (p. 4-6, p. 8).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa with 3GPP 38.901 UMi at 7 GHz: 100,000 UE channels; 70,000 sets of UEs, 60,000 for training and 10,000 for testing (p. 8).
test_conditions: Separate DNN per array, M, feedback budget and UE count, tested on 10,000 held-out sets (p. 8); PF case trained on random weights, tested with PF scheduling (p. 12).
baselines: Non-learned: all-feedback, random feedback (p=0.5), limited all-feedback, with random, opportunistic or SUS scheduling and ZF. Learned: only own variants (DO vs PG, CQI input) (p. 8-10).
metrics: Downlink sum-rate (bps/Hz), average number of feedbacks, condition number of the nominated set, CDF of mean rates, mean log utility for PF (p. 9-12).
q1_support: p. 8: "The simulation datasets are generated using the QuaDRiGa simulator [33]"; the channels come from the 3GPP 38.901 urban-microcell (UMi) model [34].
q2_support: p. 12: "trained solely through random weight sampling effectively generalized"; the PF test uses real PF weights with epsilon 100 and 1000 (p. 11), unlike the uniform random weights used in training (p. 7). Other results use one DNN per setup (p. 8), which does not count.
q3_support: p. 8: "where every user feeds back its CSI" (All FB; Random FB, Limited All FB and SUS are also non-learned). Learned comparisons are only DO vs PG, two training strategies of the same network (DO adapted from the authors' conference paper [1], p. 2), and a CQI-input variant.
q4_support: p. 4: "followed by FC layers with batch normalization and a final tanh activation"; the DNN is described without layer sizes, parameters, FLOPs or runtime, and no complexity analysis appears anywhere.
q5_support: p. 8: "The simulation datasets are generated using the QuaDRiGa simulator [33]"; the paper generates its own data and gives no code or data link.
notes: PDF is arXiv v1 (2504.16351, 23 Apr 2025), titled Self-Nomination: Deep Learning for Decentralized CSI Feedback Reduction in MU-MIMO Systems; it does not print the DOI. Area 2 because the paper frames the learned decision as CSI feedback reduction (p. 1) and the BS scheduler and ZF precoder are fixed; borderline with above_phy because the UE decision anticipates its own scheduling (p. 1). q2 rests on the PF case only (p. 12); all other results use one DNN per setup (p. 8). q3: DO is adapted from the authors' conference paper [1] (p. 2) but is presented as one of two proposed strategies, so it is treated as a variant of the method; if the reviewer accepts it as an earlier learned baseline, q3 would be 1. q5: QuaDRiGa is a public simulator, but the generated data and the code are not released.
